Ruling record · 2026-11-20T16:50Z · The maintainer answered the seat's decision card on 2026-11-20 at 16:50:40Z.

Question, verbatim: 「手机登录后：产品指定了默认应用时，先进默认应用还是上次用的应用？」
Options: 「上次用的优先」 (phone login enters the person's last-used app; the product's declared default app is used only when there is no record yet, e.g. the first login) · 「产品默认优先」 (a declared default always wins, as on desktop; last-used only when none is declared and there are several apps).
Answer, verbatim: 「上次用的优先」.

So on a phone: last-used app first; the declared default (`isDefault`) only when no last-used record exists; one app → enter it; several and neither → the app list. Desktop landing is unchanged. This applies to #35881's "where login lands" item.
